digest.component_or_area: LLM capabilities override table (Bedrock and Anthropic adapters)
propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table lists only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 with supports_temperature=False, leaving rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL (claude-opus-4-8) unguarded and causing 400 ValidationException errors when temperature is configured on Bedrock.

Both us.* and global.* Bedrock model id prefixes for opus-4-8 and opus-4-7 reject temperature parameter, but the table keys on full model id so global.* variants are unguarded when only us.* is listed.

The Anthropic adapter (pydantic-ai models/anthropic.py:641) silently drops temperature and logs a warning, while Bedrock adapter fails with 400, causing Pass-2 code-review verification (which pins temperature=0 for determinism) to resample non-deterministically in production on opus-4-8.

Temperature parameter succeeds at the API default value (temp=1.0) on opus-4-8 but fails at explicit values (0.0, 0.5), indicating deprecated tunability rather than complete unsupport, so supports_temperature=False correctly withdraws the parameter.

The override table has no entry for top_p deprecation on opus models, creating a latent defect since rebar can send sampling parameters but has no capability guard to prevent server-side 400 errors on top_p.
Both bare model ids (claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-4-7) and provider-prefixed forms (anthropic:, bedrock:) must be covered in the override table to guard both the Anthropic and Bedrock adapter paths.
